parameters.query:
SELECT id::text AS "clientId", code AS "clientCode"
FROM clients
WHERE ($1 <> '' AND id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid)
   OR ($2 <> '' AND code = $2)
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id AS "documentId", d.import_key, d.document_type AS "documentType",
       d.title, d.source_uri, d.file_path, d.checksum, d.content,
       (SELECT code FROM clients WHERE id = d.client_id) AS "clientCode",
       $1 AS "clientId"
FROM truth_documents d
WHERE d.client_id = $1::uuid
  AND d.status = 'RECEIVED' AND d.content IS NULL
  AND upper(d.document_type) IN ('PDF','WEBPAGE','URL')
ORDER BY d.received_at

SELECT ingest_extracted_truth_document(
  $1, $2::uuid, $3, $4, now(), $5) AS ingest,
  $6 AS "clientId"

SELECT d.id AS "documentId", d.import_key, d.document_type AS "documentType",
       d.title, d.source_uri, d.checksum, d.content,
       (SELECT code FROM clients WHERE id = d.client_id) AS "clientCode"
FROM truth_documents d
WHERE d.client_id = $1::uuid
  AND d.content IS NOT NULL AND d.parsed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY d.received_at

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: ($env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen2.5:0.5b'), prompt: $json.prompt, stream: false, format: 'json', options: { temperature: 0.0 } }) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT raise_exception($1::uuid, 'CLAIM_EXTRACTION_FAILED', 'HIGH',
  'WF-01 claim extraction validation failed', $2, NULL, 'CLIENT', $1::uuid, now())
  AS exception_id

UPDATE truth_documents SET parsed_at = now(), status = 'PARSED'
WHERE client_id = $1::uuid
  AND content IS NOT NULL AND parsed_at IS NULL
